chunks: So they began to think, even as you do, that God would not resurrect any one.
ai.seo_question: What did the Jinn assume about resurrection according to Surah Al-Jinn?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Jinn, this verse underscores the Jinn's skepticism regarding bodily resurrection, mirroring the disbelievers' doubt. Shia exegesis highlights this as a critique of those who deny the Hereafter based on limited perception, affirming God's absolute power to resurrect even the dead.
